home.title: E-be
home.description: The event bar management platform connecting venues and organizers.

hero.title: More Great Events, Together.
hero.subtitle: E-be connects participants with organizers. Handle bookings, attendance, and analytics — all in one place.

pain.title: Sound familiar?
pain.venue_item_1: Hard to find reliable organizers you can trust
pain.venue_item_2: Managing schedules across multiple venues is a mess
pain.venue_item_3: No clear way to measure which events actually drive revenue
pain.venue_item_4: Booking requests and approvals take too long
pain.eventer_item_1: Finding a venue takes too much time every single time
pain.eventer_item_2: Coordination is scattered across emails and messages
pain.eventer_item_3: No good way to showcase your past track record
pain.eventer_item_4: Missing tools to build repeat audiences with coupons
pain.participant_item_1: Never know when or where interesting events are happening
pain.participant_item_2: Miss out on next events by your favorite organizers
pain.participant_item_3: Anxious about the atmosphere of a new venue or event
pain.participant_item_4: Would visit more often if there were rewards or coupons

features.title: Everything you need to run great events

events.title: Event Management
events.description: Centralized booking requests, approvals, and schedule conflict checking across all your venues.

multitenant.title: Multi-venue
multitenant.description: One organization, many venues. Manage each independently while keeping a unified overview.

participants.title: Attendance & Roles
participants.description: Flexible roles for organizers, co-hosts, and attendees. Track capacity and RSVPs in one view.

ai.title: AI-Ready Analytics
ai.description: Export your performance data as structured text for AI analysis. Spot trends and popular tags fast.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.description: Issue venue-specific or org-wide coupons to drive repeat attendance and reward loyal guests.

fc.title: FC Requests
fc.description: Let top organizers apply to open new venues, matched by past performance data.

discover.title: Discover events
discover.description: Browse by area and date so you never miss what’s happening.

follow.title: Get updates
follow.description: Follow your favorite organizers and venues to catch new announcements.

coupons.title: Perks & coupons
coupons.description: Enjoy rewards that make attending and visiting even better.

how.title: Up and running in 3 steps
how.step_1_desc: Sign up free with just your email. Get started as a participant or an organizer.
how.step_2_desc: Browse available venues and submit a booking request. Proven organizers get fast-tracked.
how.step_3_desc: Once approved, your event goes live. Manage RSVPs, coupons, and post-event reports — all here.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: E-be ("we", "our", or "the Service") values the privacy of our users. This policy explains how we collect and use your information.

1.title: 1. Information We Collect
1.content: We collect your email address provided during account creation, as well as event participation history and venue information through your use of the Service.

2.title: 2. How We Use Information
2.content: The information we collect is used to provide our services, optimize matching, maintain security, and send important notifications.

3.title: 3. Third-party Sharing
3.content: We do not share your personal information with third parties without your consent, except as required by law.

terms_page.title: Terms of Service
terms_page.introduction: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of E-be ("the Service"). By using our Service, you agree to these Terms.

1.title: Section 1 (Application)
1.content: These Terms apply to all relationships between you and the Service regarding your use of E-be.

2.title: Section 2 (Prohibited Actions)
2.content: Users must not engage in any actions that violate laws or public order, harass other users, or interfere with the operation of the Service.

3.title: Section 3 (Disclaimer)
3.content: The Service is not liable for any damages incurred by users regarding the use of the Service, except in cases of intentional misconduct or gross negligence by the Service.
